description: This Java class, RenderableFtlFormElementsBuilder, provides methods to construct renderable elements for form UI components in the OFBiz framework. It generates macros for labels, input fields, date/time pickers, hyperlinks, container elements, field groups, dropdowns, and other form elements, often leveraging context parameters and supporting AJAX behaviors. The class facilitates dynamic form rendering with extensive customization options.

classes.name: RenderableFtlFormElementsBuilder
classes.description: A utility class responsible for building various renderable form elements in the OFBiz framework, encapsulating logic for labels, input fields, date/time pickers, hyperlinks, containers, field groups, dropdowns, and other form components, with support for AJAX and sub-components.

methods.name: tooltip
methods.description: Creates a macro call to render a tooltip for a form field.

methods.name: asterisks
methods.description: Generates a macro call to render required field asterisks indicator.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Creates a macro call to render a label widget.

methods.name: displayField
methods.description: Builds a macro call to render a display of a form field, possibly with in-place editing or visual cues.

methods.name: textField
methods.description: Creates a macro call for rendering a text input field, supporting validation, AJAX, and event handling.

methods.name: textArea
methods.description: Builds a macro call for rendering a textarea input, possibly with a visual editor and localization support.

methods.name: dateTime
methods.description: Creates a macro for rendering date/time picker fields, with various configuration options like masks, ranges, and input methods.

methods.name: dateFind
methods.description: Generates a date find input widget with options for date/time filtering.

methods.name: dateRangePicker
methods.description: Creates a macro call for a date range picker widget with extensive customization based on context.

methods.name: makeHyperlinkString
methods.description: Creates a hyperlink element, either as a form submit, modal, or layered link, with dynamic parameters and context awareness.

methods.name: makeHyperlinkByType
methods.description: Generates a hyperlink based on specified link type, style, target, and parameters, handling different link behaviors.

methods.name: hyperlinkMacroCall
methods.description: Builds a macro call for a hyperlink element, including image, tooltip, and URL details.

methods.name: containerMacroCall
methods.description: Creates a macro call for rendering a container (div or section) for nested form elements.

methods.name: fieldGroupOpen
methods.description: Constructs a macro call to open a collapsible or static field group with title and style.

methods.name: fieldGroupClose
methods.description: Constructs a macro call for closing a field group.

methods.name: dropDownField
methods.description: Builds a dropdown select element with options, groupings, AJAX support, and special handling for current value and additional fields.

methods.name: populateGroupAndOptions
methods.description: Helper method to recursively build group options and nested options from configuration.

methods.name: populateOptions
methods.description: Helper method to convert option value configurations into Option instances for rendering.

methods.name: createAjaxParamsFromUpdateAreas
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript CSV string for AJAX update areas, based on form configuration.

methods.name: appendToPostFormRenderableFtl
methods.description: Adds a renderable element to be included after the main form for post-submission handling.

methods.name: getPostMultiFormRenderableFtl
methods.description: Accesses the current stored post-form renderable in the context.

methods.name: setPostMultiFormRenderableFtl
methods.description: Stores a renderable for post-form submission in the context.

methods.name: getWholeFormContext
methods.description: Retrieves the whole form context map from the rendering context.

methods.name: shouldApplyRequiredField
methods.description: Determines whether a given model form field should have required validation styling applied.

methods.name: pathAsContentUrl
methods.description: Converts a given static resource path to a full content URL using the staticContentUrlProvider.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a string value with the specified encoder, considering output encoding flags.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum character length, optionally using encoded length calculation.
